notes:
Site's own nav has TWO separate, distinct top-level branches: 'Clearance' (genuine clearance taxonomy, with sub-items All Clearance / Furniture / Bath & Bedding / Kitchen & Dining / Decor) and 'Sale' (generic promotional 'Sale by Category' with %-off tiers 50/30/20/10-off, a 'First Ever Sale' campaign page, and category sale pages like furniture-sale, living-room-sale etc). Per the Sale-vs-Clearance rule, only the Clearance branch was extracted; /collection/sale (item_total=178, confirmed via page.item_total on the live grid) and its %-off/category-sale children were excluded as generic temporary promotional pages, not clearance/outlet-taxonomy. /collection/clearance (canonical, item_total=16) and /collection/clearance-all-clearance ('All Clearance' sub-nav item, also item_total=16, ~83% first-page item_code overlap with the canonical page) are the same underlying listing -- kept only the canonical /collection/clearance and dropped the alias. Real genuine sub-structure confirmed: Furniture (item_total=9) + Decor (item_total=7) = 16, exactly matching the parent's own item_total, confirming these are true non-overlapping children of the Clearance listing, so Clearance is emitted as a group parent with Furniture and Decor as its children. Two clearance sub-pages returned zero products ("items":[], item_total=0) and were dropped per the zero-product rule: Clearance Bath & Bedding and Clearance Kitchen & Dining. Separately found /collection/open-box--outlet-deals ('Open Box & Outlet Deals', item_total=5) -- although this URL is nested under the 'Sale' nav branch rather than the 'Clearance' branch, its own page title/content is explicitly Outlet-style (open-box/outlet returns and overstock), which is one of this brief's target Clearance terms (Outlet), so it was recorded as its own Clearance-family row rather than folded under the generic Sale exclusion; flagged for review given its placement under the Sale nav branch. Checked main nav, footer, sitemap/collections.sitemap.xml for clearance/outlet/final-sale/end-of-line/discontinued terms; no other candidates found. Access: direct HTTP GET throughout, no WAF/block; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow.

[POLICY UPDATE 2026-09-11] Removed 1 Outlet-classified row(s) per corrected policy: Outlet is not Clearance.
